name: crumbs
description: The way back from where a person is: the places above this one, as links, and the page itself, marked as here.

use.when: a page sits inside another, such as a record inside its list.
use.not: the main navigation, or steps in a task.
use.with: the page heading, which it leads into; leave current out when the heading already says it.

items.description: The places above this page, outermost first.

dot.description: The colour of the list this place is, drawn before it.

current.description: This page's name, marked as the current page. Leave out when the heading below says it.

a11y.role: navigation holding a list of links, the last item aria-current=page

wcag.notes: A named navigation landmark (1.3.1) with the trail as an ordered list, so its length is announced. The separators are drawn in CSS and never read. The current page is marked with aria-current and in words, not by colour alone (1.4.1). Links reach a 44px target (2.5.5).

machine.identify: Each link is a place above this page, outermost first; [aria-current=page] is the page itself.
machine.operate: Follow a link to go back to that place.
